note: WP1.55 ratchet: every transitive path by which one concrete provider package reaches the other through shared main-process modules on the base (the packages never import each other directly). Each entry is `from -> via -> to`, where `via` is the first module outside the source package. All of them come from the base's entanglement of both spawn paths with conductor-mcp-server, codex-review-mcp-tool, pty-manager, statusline-watcher and the per-session settings writer; the adapter and launch-handoff slices route those consumers through the entry points. The list may only shrink (WP2 commit 5a removed the two that reached the legacy Codex auth module through codex-review-mcp-tool); tests/wp1/dependency-boundaries.test.ts R2 fails on a new entry and on a stale one.
